Iris (design): quick sync: batch create form usability. two things: top error summary vs inline errors per field? and how explicit should "required" be?
Arjun (pm): for heavy tables top summary + anchors please. users batch upload often and inline noise is overwhelming.
Dev (eng): technically inline is easiest to implement but scales poorly on 100+ rows. we could lazy-mount inline errors on focus to compromise.
Lina (a11y): asterisk alone is unreliable. prefer visible 'Required' text linked via aria-describedby or set aria-required=true. also summary should have aria-live polite.
Iris (design): copy: current "Field required" -> propose "Please provide a value for [label]." short and actionable.
Arjun (pm): agree. destructive action pattern: typed confirm for single irreversible deletion, undo toast for recoverable/bulk deletes.
Dev (eng): typed confirm needs focus management; undo toast needs consistent retention policy. both doable.
Lina (a11y): if typed confirm is used add clear instructions and ensure SR reads the required phrase; avoid trapping focus in a way that hides controls.
Iris (design): plan: prototype summary-first variant (summary + anchor + inline-on-focus) and inline-eager variant. we'll test both in a 6-person usability round.
